title: BrightAI, which uses AI to help industrial companies detect malfunctioning equipment, raised $97M led by Smith Point, bringing its total funding to $184M (Maria Deutscher/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Maria Deutscher / SiliconANGLE: BrightAI, which uses AI to help industrial companies detect malfunctioning equipment, raised $97M led by Smith Point, bringing its total funding to $184M — BrightAI Inc., a startup that helps industrial companies detect malfunctioning equipment, has raised $97 million in funding.
